verdict.rationale: AWS Labs publishes an official open-source MCP server repo (awslabs/mcp) confirmed by both docs and probe, and AgentCore docs mention agents calling MCP servers with AWS handling auth, showing the capability exists. However, the evidence pack lacks detailed setup documentation, list of supported services/tools, or independent/hands-on corroboration of using it. Missing for 10: in-depth official docs on configuring/using the MCP server, coverage of which AWS services it exposes, and independent verification of real-world use.
